product.name: Monoprice Premium 3.5mm Stereo to 2RCA Cable - Female-to-Male 22AWG Gold Plated 6in Black
product.description: While most mobile devices use the 3.5mm stereo headphone output, most home audio systems with an amplifier or receiver use RCA jacks for audio inputs. This cable is ideal for adapting the output of your mp3 player or phone to stereo RCA plugs for connecting to your home audio system.The cable is made of heavy-duty coaxial cable for each conductor. The conductors are 22AWG and each conductor is shield to prevent EMI or RFI interference from entering your audio system. The cable is 12mm x 6mm thick, while the connector housings are about 41mm long x 15mm diameter.Warning: This product may contain a chemical known to the State of California to cause cancer, birth defects, or other reproductive harm. For more information, go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
